title: Discussing the Experiments We Are Going to Run for PyTorch 2

cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: In the last video, we discussed two cool new features in PyTorch 2.0, which was setting the device globally and setting the device with a context manager.
cues.zh: 上一段影片討論了 PyTorch 2.0 的兩個酷功能：全域設定裝置，以及透過環境管理器設定裝置。

cues.en: But now let's get focused on PyTorch 2.0, a major feature which is torch compile.
cues.zh: 現在專注在主要功能 torch.compile。

cues.en: So we're going to set up the experiments and we'll discuss what experiments we're doing in this video too.
cues.zh: 我們要設定實驗，這段影片也會討論實驗內容。

cues.en: So I'll turn that into markdown.
cues.zh: 先改成 Markdown。

cues.en: So time to test speed.
cues.zh: 該測試速度了。

cues.en: So to keep things simple, we'll run four experiments and we'll get into the details of that in a second.
cues.zh: 為了簡單，我們做四個實驗，細節稍後說明。

cues.en: Let's jump over to the keynote.
cues.zh: 切到 Keynote。

cues.en: Oh, there's a slide.
cues.zh: 喔，還有一張投影片。

cues.en: I forgot.
cues.zh: 忘了。

cues.en: For compatibility score doesn't cover anything that we haven't covered before.
cues.zh: 這是運算能力分數，沒有超出之前介紹的內容。

cues.en: But if you want to find out your GPU compute capability, you've got NVIDIA developer page.
cues.zh: 如果想知道 GPU 運算能力，可以看 NVIDIA 開發者頁面。

cues.en: And if you haven't noticed already, we're focused on just NVIDIA GPUs.
cues.zh: 如果還沒注意到，我們只專注 NVIDIA GPU。

cues.en: PyTorch two is probably going to come to non Nvidia GPUs at some point, but for now, because we have
cues.zh: 講者說 PyTorch 2 的這些功能未來應該也會支援非 NVIDIA GPU，不過現在因為

cues.en: the most access to Nvidia, we're focused on those, we're using an A100 for this demonstration.
cues.zh: 最容易取得 NVIDIA，就專注這類 GPU。示範使用 A100。

cues.en: However, PyTorch 2.0 will be capable on all GPUs that can run previous versions of PyTorch, but the SPEEDUPS will be most noticeable with those with a higher GPU compute capability score.
cues.zh: PyTorch 2.0 本身仍可在能執行舊版 PyTorch 的 GPU 上使用，但運算能力分數較高時，加速會更明顯。

cues.en: Is the experiments that we're running to test out PyTorch 2.0.
cues.zh: 這是測試 PyTorch 2.0 要進行的實驗。

cues.en: Now we've got four experiments.
cues.zh: 有四個實驗。

cues.en: They're all going to use the same model and data set.
cues.zh: 全部使用相同模型與資料集。

cues.en: We're not focused on performance or accuracy results.
cues.zh: 重點不是效能或準確率結果。

cues.en: We're focused on speed because that is what torch compile promises, speed increases.
cues.zh: 而是速度，因為 torch.compile 承諾的是速度改善。

cues.en: We're going to do two experiments, which are a single run of Resnet 50, which is available through Torch Vision and Cifar ten, which is another data set available through torch vision.
cues.zh: 先做兩個單次執行實驗，使用 torchvision 提供的 ResNet-50，以及同樣能從 torchvision 取得的 CIFAR-10 資料集。

cues.en: And because I'm using an A100, I'm going to use a fairly large batch size because as we'll discuss in a minute, the most speedups from PyTorch to Bruno come from when you're using as much of the GPU
cues.zh: 因為使用 A100，我會用較大的 batch_size，稍後會談，PyTorch 2.0 在盡可能充分利用 GPU

cues.en: as possible due to the reasons that we talked about in the intro video.
cues.zh: 時，加速幅度最大，原因在導入影片已談過。

cues.en: We're going to use an image size of 2 to 4.
cues.zh: 影像大小用 224。

cues.en: Now, the default image size for Cifar10, I believe, is 32 by 32 and may be corrected on that or 64 by 64, but it's a lot smaller than 2 to 4.
cues.zh: 我記得 CIFAR-10 預設大小是 32 乘 32，也可能我記錯，是 64 乘 64，不過肯定比 224 小很多。

cues.en: Why are we doing this?
cues.zh: 為什麼這樣做？

cues.en: Because we want to again increase the amount we're using the GPU.
cues.zh: 因為想再次提高 GPU 的使用量。

cues.en: If you have a GPU that doesn't have as much memory as an A100, you may have to reduce your batch size, but we'll do that programmatically in a second.
cues.zh: 如果 GPU 記憶體不如 A100 多，可能需要降低 batch_size；稍後會用程式處理。

cues.en: And then the main differences between these two experiments, one and two.
cues.zh: 這兩個實驗，一與二的主要差別，

cues.en: So these are going to be compared is one uses torch dot compile and one doesn't.
cues.zh: 也就是要比較的，是一個用 torch.compile，另一個不用。

cues.en: So the first one doesn't.
cues.zh: 第一個不用。

cues.en: The second one does.
cues.zh: 第二個使用。

cues.en: Then we're going to do a multi run experiment to get the average of the performance.
cues.zh: 接著做多次執行實驗，取得平均表現。

cues.en: So we don't want these two to be flukes.
cues.zh: 不希望前兩個結果只是碰巧。

cues.en: We want to run the same experiment just for five epochs.
cues.zh: 同一個實驗，每次只訓練五個週期。

cues.en: You could run these for longer, you could change any of these parameters to whatever you like.
cues.zh: 也可以跑更久，或把任何參數改成喜歡的設定。

cues.en: I'm just trying to keep it as simple as possible because if PyTorch 2.0 doesn't work on simple experiments, how's it going to work on more complicated ones?
cues.zh: 我只是盡量保持簡單，因為如果 PyTorch 2.0 在簡單實驗都不能用，複雜實驗怎麼辦？

cues.en: But in the multi run experiments, we're going to run three runs of one and two.
cues.zh: 多次執行實驗，會把實驗一和二各執行三次。

cues.en: So three and four are just one and two, but times three, and then we'll get the average of that.
cues.zh: 所以，三和四就是一和二各乘三次，再取得平均。

cues.en: So the objective here is to compare the training and testing speed with and without torch compile on single run and multi run.
cues.zh: 目標是比較有無 torch.compile，在單次與多次執行時的訓練與測試速度。

cues.en: And we'll keep the model and the data, the batch size and the image size the same across them.
cues.zh: 模型、資料、batch_size 與影像大小都維持相同。

cues.en: So let's jump back into CoLab and we'll just write this down.
cues.zh: 回到 Colab，寫下來。

cues.en: We'll run four experiments.
cues.zh: 進行四個實驗。

cues.en: So the model is going to be.
cues.zh: 模型是，

cues.en: Resnet 50.
cues.zh: ResNet-50，

cues.en: From Torchvision.
cues.zh: 來自 torchvision。

cues.en: You could use any model here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以用任何模型。

cues.en: And in fact, something that you may want to try as an extension to this is if we go into the updates of PyTorch 2.0, the release notes.
cues.zh: 其實有個延伸可以試：到 PyTorch 2.0 更新的發布說明，

cues.en: PyTorch 2.0 release is transformer models.
cues.zh: PyTorch 2.0 發布，Transformer 模型。

cues.en: Yeah.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: There we go.
cues.zh: 在這裡。

cues.en: PyTorch to Transformers.
cues.zh: PyTorch 2 的 Transformer。

cues.en: So, Resnet50 is a convolutional neural network.
cues.zh: ResNet-50 是卷積神經網路。

cues.en: However, you may see more relative speedups in transformer based models, but I'll leave that as an extension for you to check out.
cues.zh: 不過，Transformer 模型的相對加速可能更大，留給你作延伸研究。

cues.en: We'll go Cifar ten, which is also from Torch Vision.
cues.zh: 資料使用 CIFAR-10，同樣來自 torchvision。

cues.en: Basically the general idea is that tawstock compile improves almost any model.
cues.zh: 基本概念是，torch.compile 希望能改善幾乎任何模型。

cues.en: So single run and epochs three by five.
cues.zh: 單次執行，與三次、每次五個訓練週期。

cues.en: So this would be the multi run and then we want batch size 128.
cues.zh: 後者是多次執行，再設定 batch_size=128。

cues.en: Now I'm going to put a note here.
cues.zh: 我在這裡加個註記。

cues.en: That note you may want to change this depending on the amount of memory your GPU has.
cues.zh: 依 GPU 記憶體容量，可能需要調整。

cues.en: So this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這份教學，

cues.en: Focuses on an A100 and now the A100 is the same.
cues.zh: 以 A100 為主，而且 A100 也是

cues.en: The PyTorch team used to benchmark all of their results, so that's why I'm replicating that as best as I can.
cues.zh: PyTorch 團隊做各項基準測試使用的 GPU，所以我盡可能重現相同條件。

cues.en: And then image size again, 2 to 4 note.
cues.zh: 影像大小一樣 224，註記，

cues.en: Same as above.
cues.zh: 與上面相同，

cues.en: You may want to adjust this given the amount of GPU memory you have.
cues.zh: 可能需要根據 GPU 記憶體容量調整。

cues.en: And how do you know how much GPU memory you have?
cues.zh: 怎麼知道 GPU 有多少記憶體？

cues.en: We're going to cover this a bit later on, but a quick way to do it is Nvidia SMI.
cues.zh: 稍後會介紹，但快速方法是 nvidia-smi。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 這裡。

cues.en: 40GB.
cues.zh: 40 GB。

cues.en: So that's 40,960MB on the A100.
cues.zh: 也就是 A100 的 40,960 MB。

cues.en: So fairly substantial amount of GPU memory there.
cues.zh: GPU 記憶體相當多。

cues.en: One of the largest GPUs you can actually buy is the A100.
cues.zh: A100 是當時能買到的高容量 GPU 之一。

cues.en: So let's jump back into here and we are up to number two, setting up the experiments.
cues.zh: 回到這裡，來到第二部分，設定實驗。

cues.en: All the details we're going through are here.
cues.zh: 所有細節都在這裡。

cues.en: If you miss something, let's just focus on the code.
cues.zh: 如果漏了什麼可以參考，現在專注寫程式。

cues.en: I'm going to copy in this boilerplate to import the dependencies that we need.
cues.zh: 我會複製這段常用範本程式，匯入需要的相依套件。

cues.en: And if you're not sure what boilerplate means, I know I read that a few times when I first started.
cues.zh: 如果不知道 boilerplate 是什麼，我剛開始時也常看到這個詞。

cues.en: It just means code that you always often use.
cues.zh: 就是經常固定使用的那種程式。

cues.zh: 這裡沒有新東西。

cues.en: We've already gone over what that is.
cues.zh: 已經介紹過。

cues.en: So next is to create the model and transforms.
cues.zh: 接著建立模型與轉換操作。

cues.en: Now if you want to jump ahead and try to do this yourself, we've covered this type of creation in, I believe it was PyTorch transfer learning or maybe one of the other previous modules.
cues.zh: 如果想先自己試，這種建立方式在 PyTorch 遷移學習，或其他先前模組中做過。

cues.en: But we're going to create the Resnet 50 model using the new torch vision 0.1, four or later model and Weights API.
cues.zh: 我們會使用 torchvision 0.14 或更新版本的模型與權重 API，建立 ResNet-50。

cues.en: So if you want to give that a crack yourself, feel free to jump ahead, but we'll cover that in the next video.
